verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so user-configured background automations are a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no automation, rule, or scheduling feature that users can set up. The founder's description of auto-categorization is a built-in behavior, not user-configured automations. The MCP tool list (send, label, archive, delete) is a set of building blocks an external agent could drive, not a native capability that runs automations autonomously.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
